name: 李志鴻
objective:
本課程以智能化生產為核心，介紹人工智慧、資料分析與工業資訊技術的基本原理及其在製造領域的應用。課程內容涵蓋人工智慧發展、機器學習模型、資訊理論、人工神經網路、深度學習與卷積神經網路、大型語言模型、檢索增強生成（RAG）及強化學習，並延伸至工業物聯網、雲端服務、大數據與管理系統。透過異常檢測、智慧維護及虛擬量測等專題，探討相關技術如何支援生產管理與製程改善。課程亦結合氛圍編程（Vibe Coding）專題實作與報告，引導學生運用自然語言與生成式人工智慧輔助程式開發，培養整合所學、驗證成果及解決智能化生產問題的能力。

This course focuses on intelligent production, introducing the fundamental principles of artificial intelligence, data analysis, and industrial information technologies, as well as their applications in manufacturing. Topics include the development of artificial intelligence, machine learning models, information theory, artificial neural networks, deep learning and convolutional neural networks, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and reinforcement learning. The course also covers the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), cloud services, big data, and management systems. Through special topics on anomaly detection, intelligent maintenance, and virtual metrology, students explore how these technologies support production management and process improvement. The course also incorporates Vibe Coding project work and presentations, guiding students in using natural language and generative artificial intelligence to assist with software development while cultivating their ability to integrate acquired knowledge, validate results, and solve problems in intelligent production.
